brief.headline: Close the ₹1.26 Cr gap to our best Dextrose price of ₹66.48/KG while reducing single-source exposure that sits at 56% of our Dextrose volume.

priceAsk.summary: Match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG rate across the Dextrose portfolio
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG (down from current ₹68.45/KG), eliminating the ₹1.26 Cr annual excess
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji Industries Limited for equivalent material; the 3.0% gap costs us ₹1.26 Cr yearly. Export market line sits at 42.95 ₹/kg, so both prices carry margin for domestic pharma grade.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt; payment acceleration is not the priority

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja runs a 6.9% net margin and 10.1% EBITDA margin on ₹6031.59 Cr revenue, with conservative 0.13x debt-to-equity and a B (70/100) health score. Our ₹21.21 Cr spend is just 0.35% of their top line, so we're small individually. However, they're growing at 23.5%/yr and value volume commitments. We can push firmly on price — they have the margin room and the balance sheet to absorb a 3.0% rate cut — but frame it as locking in higher volume rather than a squeeze that risks the relationship when we're 56% dependent on them.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹68.45/KG while Sayaji delivers the same Dextrose at ₹66.48/KG
The price gap costs us ₹1.26 Cr every year
Dextrose Anhydrous IP alone accounts for ₹62.92 L of the overpayment
They earn a healthy 6.9% net margin on ₹6031.59 Cr revenue, so a 3% price move is absorbable
We represent only 0.35% of their revenue, limiting our individual leverage
They are growing top line at 23.5% per year and will trade price for committed volume

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker with established dextrose supply; ₹2359.06 Cr revenue and C (56/100) health score make them a credible second source to split the 56% concentration risk.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist growing capacity in starch and dextrose; ₹821.13 Cr revenue and B (63/100) health score position them as a reliable alternate.

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of a global starch major with pharma-grade dextrose capability; ₹2898.05 Cr revenue (though D (28/100) health score warrants due diligence on the local entity's stability).

risks: We source 56% of our Dextrose through them (₹21.21 Cr), so pushing too hard without a qualified second source in place could disrupt supply if they walk.
At 0.35% of their ₹6031.59 Cr revenue we lack scale leverage; frame the ask around volume growth (23.5%/yr) rather than a take-it-or-leave-it demand.
Their B (70/100) health score and 0.13x debt-to-equity show stability, not distress — they can afford to say no unless we sweeten the deal with volume or tenure.
Qualifying Gulshan, Sanstar, or Roquette will take time; telegraphing the second-source strategy too early may harden their stance before we have real alternatives ready.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to align your Dextrose rate to the ₹66.48/KG we pay Sayaji and lock in a higher volume commitment over the next 18 months — that closes a ₹1.26 Cr gap for us and gives you the growth runway you're targeting.
